title: React to more GitHub events: review submissions, failing checks, issue assignment
what: Only comments that mention the App start work. Add pull_request_review (a submitted review that mentions the App), check_run failures on pull requests the agent opened, and issue assignment to the App.

acceptance.text: A submitted review that mentions the App starts work in the pull request conversation
A failing check on an agent pull request starts a fix attempt, bounded in count
Assigning an issue to the App starts work on it
